derivation: a diminutive of a derivative probably of the base of G939 (βάσις);
def: a palm twig (as going out far)

occurrences.text: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
